paragraphs: Chanan: R. Abba bar Chanan; R. Chelbo bar Chanan; R. Yudan bar Chanan; Abba Yosi bar Chanan. [Glosses: Chanan. (a) Pesachim 101a, near the end: Rav Chanin bar Abaye said: R. Pedat said. I think it should read bar Ammi; it was not corrected. (b) Avodah Zarah 38a: “The text itself: Rabbah bar bar Chana said: R. Yochanan said.” I think it should read “The text itself: R. Chanan bar Ammi said: R. Pedat said: R. Yochanan said”; see there. (c) Eruvin 65a, near the end: R. Chanin bar Pappa said. I think it should read R. Chanina. (d) Chapter Cheresh, 65: Rav Chanan bar Pappa; see Chanina. (e) Ketubot 8b: Chanan bar Rav; that matter in Shabbat 33a has Rava, and this should be the reading. (f) Ketubot 21a: Chanan bar Rabbah; so too Sukkah 2b; it was not corrected. (g) Shabbat 121b, beginning: Rav Chanan bar Abba should read Rava. (h) Chullin 60b: Rav Chanan bar Rav should read Rava, as in the new Talmud editions. There, 63a, near the end, Rashi has bar Rabbah, Rav Chisda's father-in-law; it should read bar Rava. (i) Pesachim 117a, near the end: “the copy of Psalms in Rav Chanan bar Rav’s house”; it was not corrected.]
